description: Single source of truth for what every starter-kit project contains. Read by /new-project, scaffold-default.sh, and /update-project.

files.hookWiring: project hooks are copied into each project's .claude/hooks and wired in its settings.json. global hooks are installed to ~/.claude/hooks by /install-global and wired ONLY in ~/.claude/settings.json; project settings.json must not list them (a missing python3 hook file exits 2 and blocks tools, and listing them twice fires them twice). Plannotator hooks are owned by the tessera plugin and must not appear in any settings.json.

managedBlocks.rule: Replace everything between the markers. If absent, append at the end of the file. Never touch text outside the markers.
Not written by the kit. Refreshed by calling graph_scan on the project root, which injects the block.

globalTools.after: Run the beacon skill-discovery step for the project profile.

globalTools.install: claude plugin marketplace add dr-code/tessera && claude plugin install tessera@tessera

conflictsWith.reason: Standalone Plannotator plus the Tessera plugin duplicates ExitPlanMode hooks (tessera ADR-003). Warn and skip install instead of stacking.
